bullets.text: An SUV fell into a sinkhole near Tidel Park in Chennai, causing severe traffic jams, and the office should monitor repair works.

The DMK IT Wing criticized the TVK government over a caste-related incident in Erode, and the office should track political fallout.

IIT Hyderabad opened applications for its Applied AI professional certification programme, presenting upskilling opportunities for local talent.
